pages.text: Mages are the backbone of the town. Constructing, crafting, and defending all rely on them.$(br2)Right-click a mage to open the mage panel, where you can set equipment and view inventory (in the top-left of the mage preview).
Follow Mode: When enabled, the mage follows you and ignores town tasks.$(li)Peaceful Mode: When enabled, the mage will not attack any entity.
pages.title: The four switches on the panel

pages.text: The mage panel: gear, plus Follow, Peace, Strategy and Dismiss
$(li)Cast Strategy: Configure spells and casting order, see $(l:wandscape:magic/advanced_casting_guide)《Advanced Casting》$(/l).$(li)Dismiss: Dismiss the mage permanently.
